subject.title: feat: show a relocating status footer on in-flight channel replies

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a default-on status line for transient progress drafts as the intended product outcome, while keeping the delivered-message footer request in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/107211 open?
rationale: The branch deliberately changed from a durable-message feature to a progress-draft feature, so code review cannot decide whether that narrower UX and its default-on behavior are the accepted product direction.

options.title: Scope this PR to progress drafts
options.body: Confirm the default-on progress-draft status line, remove the closing relationship to the durable-message issue, and require Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Retain the delivered-message goal
options.body: Keep this PR aligned with the original request only if a viable channel delivery/edit lifecycle can be designed and proven.

recommendation.title: Scope this PR to progress drafts
recommendation.body: Confirm the default-on progress-draft status line, remove the closing relationship to the durable-message issue, and require Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The author owns both the original proposal and the branch's explicit pivot to the progress-draft seam.
